title: IT Network Engineer Junior, Edge Network Engineer Junior
notes: Explicitly junior-level campus network role in the Division of Information Technology - minimum qualifications are a bachelor's degree and ZERO years of professional experience, which is as clean an entry-level opening as the market offers - duties center on supporting operations, maintenance and administration of network infrastructure under senior engineers - no certification and no clearance required - in-person component required each week at the College Park campus, telework is not guaranteed - direct match for an Information Systems degree with networking fundamentals coursework

title: Information Technology Internships - Office of Information Technology
notes: County IT internship, re-verified open and currently filling for Fall 2026 - Enterprise Application Solutions division gives full software development lifecycle exposure using Java, React.js, Node.js and GraphQL, and a separate Help Desk track is also offered - 10 to 35 hours per week, hybrid with some remote allowed, onsite in Annapolis - the posting does NOT require current enrollment, so an August 2026 graduate is eligible - direct match for an Information Systems Management degree - no clearance or certification required

title: IT Specialist (Operating Systems)
notes: Federal 2210-series opening advertised at GS-5 through GS-9, squarely inside the entry-level federal band, with career progression to GS-12 without further competition - Lanham MD is one of the listed duty locations - operating systems and infrastructure support work that builds directly on networking and systems coursework - no security clearance required, standard federal background check only - closes 09/14/2026, so this is a short application window

title: Department of Aging Office Automation Analyst - Non-Merit
notes: Tier 1 technical support role in the Department of Aging computer operations group - troubleshooting applications, hardware and user issues for senior centers and nutrition sites - the stated requirement is a high school diploma plus three years of computer system experience, but additional education substitutes year for year, so a four year bachelor degree covers the experience requirement outright - a Computer Science or related bachelor degree is listed as preferred - 34 hours per week, opened 09/09/2026, continuous recruitment - no clearance and no certification required

title: IT Cybersecurity Specialist (PLCYPLN) - CES Recent Graduate
notes: Explicit Recent Graduates program - eligibility runs for two years after degree completion, and up to six years for veterans, so an August 2026 graduate is squarely in window - advertised at GG-7 through GG-11 with the GG-7 entry point inside the entry-level federal band and promotion potential to GG-12 - 2210 Information Technology Management series at Fort Meade, telework eligible - selection places the hire into a structured career development program rather than an experienced-hire slot - the posting lists Top Secret, and DoD Cyber Excepted Service recent graduate hires are normally cleared by the agency after selection rather than needing a clearance already in hand - open through 11/18/2026

title: IT Desktop Support Coordinator
notes: Desktop support on the Enterprise Desktop team within the Division of Information Technology - installs, tests and troubleshoots desktop systems, applications and AV equipment and consults one-on-one with end users - asks for a bachelor's degree plus one year of professional IT experience, so slightly above a true zero-experience opening but well within reach - CompTIA A+, Jamf and Microsoft certifications are listed as preferences only, not requirements - no clearance required - in-person component required at the College Park campus
certNote: CompTIA A+ listed as preferred, not required

title: Management Analyst I (HHS Finance and Administration)
notes: Entry-grade Analyst I on a county merit recruitment, open to the public - Requires a bachelor degree, preferably business or public administration - Business analysis and process improvement fit, less technical than his IT target roles

title: Cybersecurity Analyst Intern
notes: Req R-00190663, re-verified open on the Leidos Maryland board - analyst-track cybersecurity internship in Odenton - the posting does NOT require current enrollment, so an August 2026 graduate is eligible - posting lists Secret clearance and Leidos intern programs typically sponsor rather than requiring one already in hand - no certification required for interns

title: Computer Scientist (Recent Graduate)
notes: Recent Graduates appointment at GS-7 to GS-9 with full performance level GS-12, based at Census headquarters in Suitland and reachable on the Metro Green Line - non-sensitive low risk position, no security clearance required, telework eligible - QUALIFICATION CHECK BEFORE APPLYING: the 1550 Computer Science series carries a positive education requirement, generally a degree in computer science or a closely related field including a set number of computer science and mathematics credit hours, so the transcript should be checked against the announcement - closes 09/15/2026 or earlier once 200 applications are received

title: Finance and Business Operations Intern
notes: Paid internship with no clearance requirement listed - business operations and process analysis work that lines up with a systems analysis and business process improvement background - explicitly an internship program rather than an experienced hire - Columbia MD onsite/hybrid - reached via the Leidos Maryland internship search, req R-00191640 - a parallel posting exists in Gaithersburg MD

title: Finance and Business Operations Intern
notes: Same requisition R-00191640 as the Columbia opening but posted against the Gaithersburg MD site, so apply to whichever location is more commutable - paid internship with no clearance requirement listed - business operations and process analysis work that lines up with systems analysis and business process improvement coursework - explicitly an internship program rather than an experienced hire - no certification required

title: Election Support Technician
notes: Entry-level technical support for election systems including a SaaS application - Part-time non-benefited seasonal work - Useful short-term experience rather than a career role

title: Central Services Risk Management Internship

title: IT SPECIALIST (APPSW)
notes: Federal Direct Hire announcement filling an applications-software ladder at GS-07, GS-09 and GS-11 - the GS-07 entry point sits inside the entry-level federal band and the listed specialized experience maps well to an Information Systems background - SQL or NoSQL databases, assisting with web applications, and preparing technical documentation - scored as a stretch because the announcement asks for one year of specialized experience at the GS-06 level and states no education substitution - public trust position, no active clearance needed - open through 02/13/2027, so there is time to strengthen the application

title: NOC Support Tier I - (IT Tech I)
notes: Tier 1 first-line service desk role in the Office of Information Technology supporting county agencies and the county public libraries - ticketing, troubleshooting, Active Directory, Windows, printer management and remote support tools, which is exactly the day to day of a first IT job - scored as a stretch because the stated requirement is a high school diploma plus two years of IT service desk or NOC experience with no education substitution offered, and a college degree is listed only as a preference - A-Plus, Network-Plus and ITIL are preferences, not requirements - 39 hour week with weekend rotation and on-call - closes 09/16/2026
